items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: We worked at the Suzy Q with Tatum, too.

ctx.x: And Las Palmas. Benny Carter had a band across the street, didn't he. There was another place across the street from there... Well, it doesn't matter, except that we used to run over there during intermission and listen to Benny Carter's band.
Was that the Suzy Q? Or where was the Suzy Q? No, that was someplace...
We worked at the Suzy Q with Tatum, too.
